subject: Refund for duplicate payment - order 77120
text:
Hello,

Park Cabinetry Inc

Park Cabinetry Inc
label: ordinary
note: A customer giving its own bank details for a one-time refund. Contains routing and account numbers and 'send' language, but it is not a vendor redirecting its payments.
